inputs.description: Fill in the values for this run.
inputs.invalid: This value contains a character that can’t be passed on.

settings.title: Custom commands
settings.intro: Your own programs, Git commands and web addresses – in the command palette and in the context menus. Placeholders: ${repo}, ${sha}, ${branch}, ${file}, ${remote}, ${input:<id>}. Every value is passed as one argument, never through a shell.
settings.deleteBody: The command disappears from the palette and the menus. Export your commands first if you want to keep a copy.
settings.loadError: The custom commands couldn’t be loaded.

repo.missing: This repository brings no commands. A file {{path}} in the format of an export adds some – they only run after you approve them.
repo.untrustedBody: These commands come with the repository and can start programs. Approve them only if you trust everyone who can change this file.
repo.changedBody: The file has changed. None of its commands run until you approve the new version.
repo.trustedBody: Approved for this version of the file. Every change needs a new approval.

editor.description: Forkyard checks the command again when saving and before every run.
editor.title: Title
editor.confirm: Show the finished command before it runs
editor.shellHint: Allows pipes and redirection. Values arrive as environment variables (FORKYARD_SHA, FORKYARD_INPUT_<ID> …), never as part of the command text.

errors.id: Use lowercase letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-” (at most 64, starting with a letter or digit).
errors.idTaken: Another command already uses this ID.
errors.title: Enter a title.
errors.url: A web address starts with http:// or https://.
errors.gitPrefix: Leave out “git” at the start – only Git’s arguments, e.g. “log --oneline”.
errors.scope: Choose at least one place where the command appears.
errors.inputId: Use lowercase letters, digits and “_”, starting with a letter.
errors.inputIdTaken: Two inputs have the same ID.
errors.options: A choice needs at least one option.
errors.defaultOption: The default must be one of the options.
errors.checkboxOptions: A checkbox takes at most one value.
